voice.summary: Sounds like a well-made instrument panel label: exact, short and unfussy. Every control says what it sets and shows the value beside it.
dos: Label controls with a noun, then the live value
donts: No marketing copy on a control surface
No ambiguous toggles without a state word

boilerplate: Tuner is a settings and filtering interface with range sliders, steppers, segmented switches and knobs, each showing its value live and working fully from the keyboard.

microcopy.error: Value out of range, adjust and retry

logo.note: A dial is the natural icon for a product built around tuning values.
